renew.title: Renew “{name}”
renew.intro: Issues a new certificate with the same common name and issuer, and a fresh key pair. The certificate being replaced is revoked as superseded and keeps a pointer to the replacement, so what was deployed stays on the record.
renew.commonNameHelp: A renewal keeps the common name. To change it, issue a new certificate instead.
renew.sanHelp: One name per line, or separated by commas. The common name is always included, and the key pair is regenerated.
renew.validityHelp: Counted from now, and it cannot outlive the signing intermediate CA.
renew.unlockReason: Renewing “{name}” needs the signing CA's private key
renew.chipTitle: This certificate was replaced by a renewal; the live one carries serial {serial}.
